d: The General Manager – Tendering & Sales is responsible for leading, strategizing, and directing all commercial, business development, estimation, proposals, and tendering operations for major MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing) construction projects. This executive role drives revenue growth, expands market presence, ensures competitive pricing strategies, and maintains accurate risk management frameworks from initial inquiry to final contract award.
q: Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
Master’s Degree in Business Administration or Executive Management qualification is preferred.
Professional affiliations (e.g., PMP, CEng, or equivalent) are advantageous.
15- 20 years of progressive experience in MEP construction industry.
At least 7-10 years in a senior leadership role managing large-scale MEP tendering, estimation, and sales.
Proven track record of winning multi-million dollar MEP contracts across varied sectors (Commercial High-Rise, Hospitals, Data Centers, Infrastructure, Mega Developments).
Deep technical expertise across all MEP disciplines (HVAC, High/Low Voltage systems, Fire Protection, Plumbing, Building Automation Systems).
Advanced knowledge of estimation software (e.g., Candy/RibCCS, CostX, or customized ERP/Excel platforms), BIM workflows, and FIDIC contract conditions.
Superior executive presentation, negotiation, and high-level interpersonal communication skills.
Strong leadership, strategic agility, risk assessment capability, and business acumen.
Strong planning, organizational, analytical, stakeholder, team management skills & problem-solving skills.
Duty Shift / Timings: One Shift / 08:00 AM to 04:00 PM
r: Formulate and execute strategic sales and growth plans aligned with the company’s business objectives for MEP contracting (HVAC, Electrical, Low Voltage, Plumbing, Firefighting, and Infrastructure/Utilities).
Identify, evaluate, and target high-value MEP construction opportunities across commercial, residential, industrial, healthcare, data center, and infrastructure sectors.
Build and maintain senior-level relationships with client representatives, main contractors, consultants, project managers, government bodies, and real estate developers.
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, pipeline status, and upcoming mega-projects to position the company competitively.
Oversee and lead the complete end-to-end tendering process for multi-discipline MEP tenders (Lump Sum, Design & Build, Framework Agreements, Unit Rate contracts).
Review tender documents, conditions of contract (FIDIC), scope of work, technical specifications, and engineering drawings to establish clear bidding strategies.
Direct estimation teams in preparing precise Quantity Take-Offs (QTO), direct and indirect cost estimates, preliminary budgets, equipment pricing, and cash flow projections.
Establish pricing strategies, value engineering solutions, markups, and profit margin targets in consultation with executive leadership.
Lead the technical and commercial proposal generation to ensure alignment with client specifications and local standards/codes.
Drive Value Engineering (VE) initiatives during pre-tender stages to offer optimized, cost-effective technical alternatives without sacrificing quality or compliance.
Coordinate with procurement and supplier networks to secure competitive quotes for major plant, equipment, and subcontractor packages.
Conduct comprehensive risk analysis and commercial evaluations on tender conditions, payment terms, performance bonds, guarantees, and liability exposure.
Lead final commercial negotiations and contract discussions with clients/main contractors prior to contract signing.
Ensure clear, seamless handovers from the Tendering/Sales team to Project Execution and Operations teams upon project award.
Lead, mentor, and build a high-performing team of Tendering Managers, Estimation Engineers, Proposal Engineers, and Business Development Executives.
Set Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), perform regular performance appraisals, and foster a continuous learning environment focused on technical precision and market responsiveness.
Implement best-in-practice estimation tools, digitize bidding processes, and improve tender conversion/win ratios.

In this role, you are responsible for deploying, migrating, and managing infrastructure services, with the capability to manage various versions of Linux and Container Platforms. As a Linux Engineer, you will lead the administration and support of mission-critical Linux environments hosted on physical, virtual, and hybrid platforms.

This role encompasses lifecycle management, performance tuning, and automation of operating system-related processes to ensure stability and high availability. Key focus areas include automation, security measures, and continuous system optimization, supporting infrastructure projects and day-to-day operational needs.
q: Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent combination of education and experience
Typically 6+ years of relevant work experience in industry, with a minimum of 3+ years in a similar role
Proven experience in infrastructure technology analysis
Proficiencies in data analysis and technical knowledge
A continuous learner who stays abreast of industry knowledge and technology
Advanced knowledge of Linux OS internals and kernel tuning
Experience with virtualization (Hyper-V, VMware) and hybrid infrastructure
Awareness of CIS hardening, log forwarding, and SIEM integration, and proficient in security compliance standards and OS-level auditing
Experience with Ansible, Puppet, or similar automation tools
Experience in setting up Linux Centralized management tools (RedHat Satellite/SUSE Manager) and patch management
Good knowledge of hybrid IT environments
An advanced degree in a relevant field is a plus
Relevant certifications, such as Linux / AIX Certifications
r: Set up and manage Linux systems (RHEL, CentOS, SUSE) for critical infrastructure
Automate OS deployments, patching, and configuration using Ansible and Jenkins
Integrate Unix systems with security controls and monitoring tools to ensure compliance with security standards
Analyze performance bottlenecks and provide permanent fixes via root cause analysis of Linux/AIX systems
Collaborate on DR readiness and participate in high-availability testing
Provide technical support in infrastructure services, responding to issues and assisting in tasks
Contribute to the implementation of infrastructure projects and assignments
Support the development of infrastructure documentation, including incident logs and configuration records
Apply technical knowledge to address Linux infrastructure-related challenges
Follow established best practices and standards in infrastructure service delivery

d: Salary: USD $10,000–$12,000 net per month + health insurance + 20 days' annual leave

Our client is an international engineering and project delivery organisation specialising in the development and delivery of major energy and infrastructure projects across the Middle East and wider international markets.

The company is currently involved in the delivery of a multi-billion-dollar power and water facility in Kuwait and is seeking an experienced, commercially and contractually focused professional to join the project team.

The project is currently in the construction phase and involves the management of three lump-sum EPC contracts. The successful candidate will work closely with the Contracts Manager, supporting the assessment and management of contractual claims, variations, payment applications and other commercial and contractual matters, including an active Force Majeure claim.

This is a hands-on role requiring strong EPC contractual experience within process industries, the ability to independently assess complex contractual matters, and the confidence to contribute immediately within a major project environment.

The successful candidate will support the contractual and commercial management of multiple EPC contracts, working closely with the project team to assess claims, protect contractual positions and ensure contractual entitlements are properly evaluated and substantiated.

The role will involve reviewing contractor submissions, assessing contractual entitlement, managing variations and payment applications, and supporting the preparation of claims and formal contractual submissions. A particular focus will be the assessment and management of Force Majeure matters.
r: Assess and manage contractual claims arising under lump-sum EPC contracts.
Review, evaluate and negotiate contractor variations and change orders.
Assess payment applications and ensure contractual and commercial entitlement is properly substantiated.
Analyse and manage Force Majeure claims, including reviewing contractual provisions, supporting documentation, causation and entitlement.
Prepare and review claims narratives, contractual submissions and supporting documentation.
Support the preparation and management of upstream claims and contractual notices.
Monitor contractual obligations, risks and entitlements across multiple EPC contracts.
Provide contractual and commercial support to the project team on ongoing project matters.
Work closely with the Contracts Manager and other project stakeholders to resolve contractual issues and protect the project's commercial position.
Support dispute resolution processes, negotiations and, where applicable, formal dispute proceedings or arbitration.
Strong experience in Quantity Surveying, Contract Management, Claims Management or a closely related commercial and contractual discipline.
Proven experience working on lump-sum EPC contracts within process industries, such as power generation, water treatment, desalination, oil & gas, petrochemicals or industrial plants.
Demonstrable experience assessing contractual claims, variations and payment applications.
Direct, hands-on experience with Force Majeure claims is essential.
Strong understanding of EPC contractual frameworks, entitlement, risk allocation and claims procedures.
Experience preparing or reviewing claims narratives, contractual submissions and supporting documentation.
Excellent analytical, contractual and commercial skills.
Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
Ability to work independently, take ownership of contractual matters and contribute effectively from day one.
Willingness to relocate to Kuwait and work full-time on-site.
Client-side, developer-side or owner-side EPC project experience.
Experience managing Force Majeure claims through formal dispute resolution, adjudication or arbitration.
Experience working in the Middle East and familiarity with regional contracting practices.
Experience working on major power, water, desalination or industrial projects.
Opportunity to join a multi-billion-dollar power and water project in Kuwait.
Exposure to complex contractual matters across three major EPC contracts.
Direct involvement in claims, variations, payment assessments and Force Majeure matters.
A hands-on role within an active construction project, working closely with senior contract management.
International project exposure within the power, water and process industries.
Competitive tax-free/net monthly remuneration, alongside health insurance and annual leave.

d: We are looking for an experienced Senior IT Managed Services Specialist to oversee IT service operations, manage service requests and incidents, monitor service performance, and ensure compliance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs). The ideal candidate will have strong experience in managed services, operational reporting, performance monitoring, and working with Oracle and SQL databases.
q: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
Minimum 5 years of practical experience in managed services, IT service operations, or IT systems support.
Strong experience in service request management, incident management, and problem management.
Practical experience in SLA monitoring, KPI analysis, service reporting, and escalation management.
Experience coordinating with technical teams, stakeholders, and business users.
Experience working with Oracle and SQL databases.
Strong analytical, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage priorities, handle escalations, and monitor multiple service activities simultaneously.
Previous experience in Saudi government projects, particularly labor-sector systems and services, is highly preferred.
r: Manage and monitor the full lifecycle of IT service requests, incidents, and problems.
Ensure compliance with SLAs, operational procedures, and service delivery standards.
Monitor and analyze service performance indicators and KPIs, identify trends, and recommend improvements.
Prepare periodic operational reports, performance dashboards, and management updates.
Coordinate with technical teams, stakeholders, and beneficiary entities to ensure timely issue resolution and service delivery.
Monitor escalations, prioritize critical requests, and follow up on outstanding issues.
Identify recurring incidents and service bottlenecks and support root cause analysis.
Maintain accurate service documentation and ensure adherence to approved processes.
Support the operation and monitoring of IT systems and services involving Oracle and SQL databases.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives to enhance service quality and operational efficiency.
